programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.desc: Ruth (Roseanne Barr) doesn't just vow to get her husband back from a romance novelist (Meryl Streep).

programme.title: Married To The Mob
programme.desc: When her mobster husband is iced by a ruthless kingpin, Angela finds a job in a beauty salon.

programme.title: Raging Bull

programme.title: City Hall

programme.title: Men Don't Leave

programme.title: Nothing but Trouble

Plunking himself down in the middle of suburbia, he rents a room from Charlie (Christopher Lloyd) and Jenny Wilcox (Shelley Duvall). Shep attempts to acclimate himself -- he skateboards, he accosts a mail carrier -- but he's destined to be a fish out of water. But when his outer space enemies arrive and pick a fight with his new friends, Shep is ready to prove his mettle.

programme.title: My Sister's Keeper

As Peter helps Luke's father (Martin Landau) and high school sweetheart (Laurie Holden) reopen the town's sole movie theater, questions arise about his true identity and motivations.

programme.title: Big Girls Don't Cry ... They Get Even
programme.desc: Fed up with her dysfunctional family, Laura (Hillary Wolf) runs away from her stepsiblings, half-siblings, divorced parents and stepparents just before the family takes a trip to Hawaii, supposedly as a celebration for her forgotten birthday. Whether hiding out with Josh (Dan Futterman), the one stepbrother Laura likes, or hitchhiking with quirky strangers, Laura is determined to escape her family -- even as her family seeks to find her and their own equilibrium.

programme.title: Graffiti Bridge
programme.desc: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Love threatens to come between a drunken playboy and his inheritance.

programme.desc: A cutting-edge, live action/animated action adventure comedy about one white blood cell's (Chris Rock) race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus (Laurence Fishburne). Bill Murray stars as Frank, in whose body the action unfolds.

programme.title: The Man With Two Brains
programme.desc: A doctor's love for a brain sends him on a search for a body to hold it.

programme.title: The Bonfire of the Vanities

programme.title: Mr. Wonderful

programme.title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes

After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

programme.title: Ladyhawke

Navarre and his lover Lady Isabeau d'Anjou (Michelle Pfeiffer) were cursed by the wicked Bishop of Aquila (John Wood), who desires Lady Isabeau for himself. His dark magic prevents the pair from ever being in each other's presence except at twilight, so they enlist Gaston in a dangerous plot to overthrow the Bishop and break his evil enchantment.

programme.title: Deal of the Century
programme.desc: An arms dealer attempts to sell war planes to a South American dictator.

programme.title: The Year of Living Dangerously
programme.desc: An Australian reporter and photographer get more than they'd bargained for.

programme.title: Honeymoon in Vegas

programme.title: Strange Brew

The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

programme.title: Fathers' Day
programme.desc: Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: A world-weary cop must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness.

programme.title: Lone Star

programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: The Black Book

Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Secrets and Spies

programme.title: The Glitch

American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Small Mercies

Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: The Great and the Good

Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: The Dagger Club

Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: Murder by Magic

programme.title: The Ballad of Midsomer County
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates whether a ballad made famous by a late, lamented folk singer could have been the inspiration for a murder. Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: A Vintage Murder
programme.desc: Barnaby tries to find out just who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery - what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: Death in the Slow Lane

During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Dark Secrets
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Echoes of the Dead
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: The Oblong Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The Sleeper Under the Hill
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: The Night of the Stag
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: A Sacred Trust
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: A Rare Bird
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister? Barnaby and Jones attempt to discover the truth.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eleven
programme.desc: When the wife of a wealthy landowner is bludgeoned to death with a cricket bat, DCI Tom Barnaby and his team are enmeshed in a succession of calculating murders. Once again, blackmail, deceit, greed and revenge threaten to destroy Midsomer's tranquillity.

programme.title: Blue Herrings

It is not until another seemingly healthy resident dies and rumours of fraud and deception emerge that Alice Bly feels the compulsion to ask her favourite nephew, DCI Tom Barnaby, to investigate.

programme.title: Judgement Day
programme.desc: The locals fear their chances of winning the Perfect Village competition have been dashed when a petty thief is stabbed to death with a pitchfork. Things spiral out of control when two of the competition judges are also murdered, leaving DI Tom Barnaby to track down the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Death of a Stranger

programme.title: Dance with the Dead

What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.desc: Orion's Crown has been stolen and is up for grabs at a black-market auction. Lupin has his eyes on the crown and the auction money, but he must outsmart the other parties vying for the crown first.

programme.title: The Traverse of Terror Murder Case (Part 1)
programme.desc: Half a year ago, Mr. Ushio had asked the notorious hitman Fox to kill him but he has since changed his mind. He now wants Kogoro to stop it from happening.

programme.title: The Snow Woman Legend Murder Case
programme.desc: Conan and the others meet the actress Akiko Kinoshita and her stunt double Yoko Asanuma while lodging overnight on a ski trip.

programme.title: Kogoro's Date Murder Case
programme.desc: Kogoro runs into Sachiko, his old acquaintance, behind a local middle school. Sachiko tries to leave in a rush but changes her mind and invites Kogoro to a short drive.

programme.title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
programme.desc: The president of Ichikawa Industries hires Kogoro to keep watch over both of his daughters who might attempt to murder him.

programme.title: The Famous Potter Murder Case (Part 1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ran and Kogoro are invited to the home of Kikuemon, a famous potter. Kikuemon claims to be a big fan of Kogoro and gifts him a valuable piece of pottery.

programme.title: The Famous Potter Murder Case (Part 2)
programme.desc: Kikuemon's daughter-in-law is found dead. Everyone thinks it's suicide due to her guilt of breaking a valuable piece, but Conan thinks it's a murder case.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Lesbians
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Helen and Gerald befriend two chic lesbians, Jenn and Suki, in order to get on the Greenville Art Council.

programme.title: Helen's Back
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Days before the Organic Gardening Club is to review the Goode's garden, Helen hurts her back.

programme.title: Pleatherheads
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Ubuntu feels untalented until he is recruited for the football team. His success as left tackle brings out Helen's long-repressed football hysteria.

programme.title: Bizaar Shorts Collection
programme.desc: A Collection of Short Films Curated by Bizaar Studios, ranging from the comedic to horrific, find it all here.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Going Under
programme.desc: When 15 Division goes undercover at a club-land bar, Chris's erratic behavior make Dov suspicious.

programme.title: Two Truths and a Lie
programme.desc: As the officers try to hunt down the killer of Brian Gowdy - Andy and Sam go on the road for interviews.

programme.title: Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: Oliver prepares Andy to defend herself at Duncan's dismissal hearing, now happening two hours from now.

programme.title: Exit Strategy
programme.desc: An innocuous call to a middle-class home puts Dov and Chris in the middle of a home invasion investigation.

programme.title: Moving Day
programme.desc: 15 Division works on a program to help tenants move out of a subsidized-housing complex that's being torn down

programme.title: Fragments
programme.desc: Andy's former rookie, Duncan, is back on duty and looking to reconcile - something she's not ready for yet.

programme.title: Everlasting
programme.desc: The officers work to find a bomber. But after catching him, they realize he has more targets set to explode.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: Andy is attacked by an intruder at Traci's place and the Sex Crimes Unit steps in to take over the case.

programme.title: Perfect Family
programme.desc: Andy debates her future with Sam after learning the heart-breaking news that Marlo is pregnant with his baby.

programme.title: Uprising
programme.desc: A riot breaks out at a women's prison while Andy, Juliet, Nick, and Gail are there to transfer prisoners.

programme.title: Letting Go
programme.desc: Nick's estranged older brother emerges with new information on someone from their tragic past.

programme.title: A Real Gentleman
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the gun dealer they're after has kidnapped her.

programme.title: Home Run
programme.desc: After a baseball game erupts in a drive-by shooting, Gail and her brother search for the shooter.

programme.title: Best Man
programme.desc: Andy and Sam are shocked to learn that Oliver is the prime suspect in IA's corruption investigation.

programme.title: Integrity Test
programme.desc: Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.

programme.title: Ninety Degrees
programme.desc: A heat wave hits and Jarvis opens the division to the public as a cooling station.

programme.title: Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Now that Sam and Marlo's baby girl has arrived, it's clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment.

programme.title: 74 Epiphanies
programme.desc: With the 15 Division restructure looming, Andy and Sam's wedding lets the gang celebrate one last hurrah.

programme.title: Fresh Paint
programme.desc: A high-stakes takedown goes awry upon the revelation that rookie cop Andy McNally has busted one of her own.

programme.title: Mercury Retrograde
programme.desc: As the other rookies hunt for an escaped convict, Swarek lets Andy in on his past undercover exploits.

programme.title: Fite Nite
programme.desc: The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at "Fite Nite."

programme.title: Signals Crossed
programme.desc: Andy trades in her uniform for something more risqué when she goes undercover as a prostitute.

programme.title: Broad Daylight
programme.desc: During a home invasion, Andy is left alone and confronted with a hiding thief who is armed and very volatile.

programme.title: Bullet Proof
programme.desc: A fatal traffic collision reveals a shocking truth, and Andy's romance with Det. Callaghan gets complicated.

programme.title: Hot & Bothered
programme.desc: A heat wave has wreaked havoc on the city, multiplied by growing fears of a serial rapist on the loose.

programme.title: Honour Roll
programme.desc: Andy and Chris investigate a nightclub beating, but all clues point to a cop.

programme.title: Girlfriend of the Year
programme.desc: At a highway accident, Chris and Gail stumble upon a car that has a license plate matched to an Amber Alert.

Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Ted Kennedy and Jenna Jameson battle celebrities in politics and porn! Link's looking for a decent reward from Princess Zelda. The Homeless Airlines sorta takes flight. Learn whatever happened to the Micro Machines Man. Skeletor's latest plot against Eternia and He-Man goes a little too well.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Another Black Man in a Fat Suit movie. Big Jim tries to score. A cat in a hat has his way with the family pet and the kids need to get lost. When Snarf kicks it, Mumm-Ra sees his chance to destroy The Thundercats as Lion-O's new nanny.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The dinosaurs face their Armageddon. Barbie and a Brat go head-to-head on MTV's Exposed. What happens on Tuesday, when Wimpy has to pay for his burgers? Greatest American Hero, or Greatest American Nerd? Find out how infinite wealth has affected Richie Rich's teenage years.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: An alien invasion isn't quite what it seems. Haunted Houses are common, but not one with THIS kind of ghost! Can Bob the Builder take on the mafia? Probably. "Inside The Battlefield" revisits G.I. Joe's and Cobra's battle of the Weather Dominator, 20 years later.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Our PS3 Contest winner gets what's coming to him. Mr. Rogers is turning Japanese. Spawn faces the Devil with his one true skill - fiddling. Fonzie takes care of Cha-Chi the best he can in The Pursuit of Happy Days. Iron Man's feet become his greatest weakness. VH1's "Top 100 Final Episodes" features the end of Mork & Mindy, Love Boat and more.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Empire Strikes Back's Lando Calrissian led our heroes into a dinnertime trap with Darth Vader, and hilarity's the main course! In the spirit of 300 comes 1776. Michael Moore uncovers whatever happened to the girls' toys of yesteryear.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Michelin Man helps out... with his life! Crystar, the Crystal Warrior, gets smoked! Thelma and Louise regret their suicidal ways. The Maytag Repairman's life REALLY sucks. The Laff-A-Lympics gang face their darkest games ever: Munich, 1972.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Kool-Aid Man quenches some inconvenient thirsts. The mystery of why Encyclopedia Brown's parents aren't getting along. What new realm will D&D's Venger conquer next? Wonder Woman reveals her revealing arch-enemy. Celebrities are drunk, but that's not why they go to rehab-they go to conquer the world! (Or something.)

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Never seek the help of She-Ra, Princess of Power, when she's on her period. Danny and the gang from Grease are building a new kind of sex-machine. The Intensive Care Bears care more than their HMO will allow. The E.T. video game almost killed Atari, and his next target... is you! Nobody in Smurf Village ever expected the dam to break... the poor bastards.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: ...Christmas Special: Hermey the Elf sucks at being a dentist. All Sally wants is a love note, but for Linus it's Misery. A nerd is stuffed into a locker and into the magical and confusing land of Narnia.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Super Friends make way for The Super Pets. The Carmen Sandiego host has girlfriend troubles. Pac-Man learns that he's been living in the Matrix. The car version of Voltron get to the rescue as fast as it can. The Cenobites guest star on Girls Gone Wild. 24 focuses on the night hours as Drac takes down the terrorists.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Conan tells us "What is Best in Life" with a song. The Nerds find out Revenge comes with a price. President Jenna Bush trades the Oil Crisis for the Corn Crisis. The Saved By The Bell kids meet Jigsaw from Saw, and Screech will never be the same. The Borg track the Enterprise to its hiding place-Las Vegas' "Star Trek Experience".

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Sylar gets a new power in a Heroes parody. Mr. Magoo gets Laser Eye Surgery. Tarzan learns that not everything humans can teach him are as good as Jane's boobs. When Paris Hilton was stuck in prison, it was up to Nicole Richie to stage a Prison Break.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Vic Mackey from The Shield switches places with the Fantastic Four's Thing and it's funny. Cowboys on a cattle drive have it bad in biblical proportions. Bronson Pinchot and Ludacris star in the off-Broadway production of "Don't Be Ridiculous". Fraggle Rock meets Watership Down when the Fraggles are forced out of their home and onto a desperate hunt for survival.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Diggers have Dug their own grave, Dig Dug-style, ya dig? You've never seen a Vegas crime caper like Ocean's Thirty-Eight. The government tries to contain an outbreak of cooties. Teenagers are exposed to movie trailers, but they're not exactly watching the screen.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The latest Japanese commercial for a yeast infection cream needs a famous pitch-woman. The enemies of America are on the run as President Bush becomes... Captain Texas! If only the Kryptonians had watched Jor-El's Inconvenient Kryptonian Truth. Sir Mix-A-Lot knows what King Arthur needs! A Glo Worm saves the day when a blackout strikes. We dedicate the season to the staff we've lost... and killed.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken returns for its fourth season, with the help of guest stars Joss Whedon, Ron Moore and Seth MacFarlane! Tila Tequila's "A Shot at Love" reveals a deadly secret. The creators imagine: what if Parappa the Rapper had to rap for his life? Movie and TV favorites are trimmed down to "Just the Good Parts."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine the contractor in charge of building those awesome Indiana Jones temples, Jason Voorhees gets ready for Friday the 13th, witness another death of another salesman and what might happen when the Justice League of America suffers through "Bring a Sidekick to Work Day."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Witness the aftermath of Pluto Nash box office. The creators imagine the truth behind James Bond's sex life, Iron Man's unexpected ally and a Skeletor plot involving a less-than-perfect clone.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Find out the only way to kill a werewolf! Discover the secret origin of Composite Santa Claus! The creators imagine a deleted scene from "Daredevil" movie, and what might happen if Hannah Montana had a date... with murder!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Joey Fatone pitches his idea for a sketch, Gobots prove they're no Transformers, the creators imagine where Billy Joel might get his musical inspiration from and who you might call if The A-Team's not available.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine how Babar might rule with an iron tusk, where O.J. might search for his ex-wife's killer and what Skynet might send back as their next Terminator, plus check out the latest superhero movie.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine Zeus spicing up The Clash of the Titans.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Giving Tree has much to give, everyone loves InuYasha plus the creators imagine what happens when Punky Brewster discovers boys and who Stephen King's new neighbor might be.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine how Freddy Krueger got his start, what would happen if the Monchhichis drew first blood, how Criss Angel delivers the Ultimate Mind Freak, and what a day with the Living Lohans might be like.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine an alternate ending to Armageddon, what a new Star Trek character might look like, the excitement that is M.A.S.K. And the WWF's new up and coming challenger.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Simon Belmont knows what works, Kermit introduces everyone to his cousin and the creators imagine what the new Gone With The Wind Re-make might look like, plus Annie Warbucks celebrates her Super Sweet Sixteen.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Superman takes it all off, meet the original Dukes of Hazzard, the creators imagine what the new Wii might look like and things come to blows when the Smurfs take on the Snorks.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Batmobile loses its wheel, spend a night with Jack Sparrow, the creators imagine what happens when Chris Hanson can't catch a predator, plus Gyro-Robo adds some depth to D & D.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Due to Constraints of Time and Budget
programme.desc: Indiana Jones knows when to keep his eyes shut, Transformers mourn a fallen hero, the creators imagine what goes on in a Yellow Submarine, plus meet the new Transporter.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Batman gets a new look at Two Face, G.I. Joe celebrate their years in service, the creators imagine what the next Traveling Pants movie might look like, plus a new Dark Crystal for the next generation.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine what the Humping Robot might look like on the big screen, John Connor tests out the new Terminator, Fantasy Island lives up to its name and the Nerd lands somewhere over the rainbow.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Please Do Not Notify Our Contractors
programme.desc: Jason Bourne gets a new identity, the new Bachelor's a beast, the creators take a skewed look at the Holy Grail and meet a character who knows how to speed things along

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine the origin of the Wuzzles, what Cloverfield's real intention was, a new spin on Hitchcock's Rear Window, plus a super sappy season ender.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Thor celebrates Christmas in Asgard, Santa adds Walter PPK to the bad boy list and the creators take a skewed look at The Gift of the Magi. Plus who needs Rudolph when Santa has Comet?

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Come celebrate the holidays with Robot Chicken and see what the very first Christmas was like! Find out what the creators imagine Batman and Robin think about their Christmas jingle - hint: don't sing it if you value your life. And the age-old question is finally answered...who's faster: Superman or Santa Claus.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Season Five of Robot Chicken opens with a bang on the beaches of Normandy! The creators imagine how Cabbage Patch Kids are made, what the real reaction to shows like STOMP! are, and we see what Skeletor is forced to do when Snake Mountain is forclosed on.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Discover the secret origins of Mo-Larr, Eternian Destist! Lara Croft makes a terrifying find in a tomb, He-Man's father proves that sometimes the apple falls very, very far from the tree, and the creators imagine how Gargamel might finally get the best of the Smurf's in Smurfitar!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine what goes on deep in the jungles of Pandora late at night, Harold and his purple crayon go on an adventure in a bad neighborhood, Major Nelson uses Jeannie to get back at NASA for firing him, and everyone in the G.I. Joe ranks gets to animal sidekick.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Kim Possible's Dr. Drakken gets sent to prison, NASA's Lego people have a very bad launch day; see how Andy treats his toys after he comes home from college in Toy Story 4, and we find out what happened to some of our most memorable TV characters from the 90's. All this and more from the minds of the creators.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Find out what crimes your Thanksgiving turkey committed and was then pardoned for. The creators re-imagine the movie Marley and Me. See who earns the title of lamest villain ever.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators give us the best 60 seconds in TV history! Plus find out how the ice cream sundae was created; what having "Spider-sense" is really like, and if the Keebler Elves can defend their home against their greatest enemy: The Cookie Monster!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Baby needs-a-name, from Strawberry Shortcake, gets a name no one will ever forget; a roast for Cobra Commander has a surprise ending and the creators finally reveal the secret of what happened to Skeeter from Muppet Babies.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Is the voice that Mortal Kombat's Johnny Cage hears real or just in his own head? Also, the creators tackle the question of what was going through Morgan Freeman's mind during his 2008 car crash. Find out what happens when a group of mentally challenged soldiers take on Hitler and the SS.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Catch Me If You Kangaroo Jack
programme.desc: The creators ponder what a Diablo Cody eulogy would be like -- home-skillett; the Joker finally gets what's coming to him and find out how the Robot Chicken Nerd would fare in the world of Tron.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine what CHiPs would have been like if the cops had actual potato chip heads, a magical zebra helps out a man with a broken cell phone, Green Lantern wears his ring on another part of his body, and the Bloopers Host returns with clips from his life.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: See! Rubik the Amazing Cube as he returns for one last adventure. Watch! As kids try out the newest fad - getting Supe'd. Discover! The secret behind a small doorway in a little boys room. And finally, the creators imagine what Eternia's 24-hour gym might be like.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Will the world ever find out what Master Chief looks like under his mask? What is life like for the pink Frankenstein's Monster, Frankenberry? How did Princess Toadstool's parents react when they first met Mario? How will the Scarecrow survive his time in the prison called Oz? The creators answer these questions and more in this thrilling episode!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Think being a witch or wizard would be fun? The creators show you what life in Hogwart's would really be like. Ever wonder why Winnie the Pooh likes honey so much? Can you say addict? Find out why Donald Duck's nephew's spend so much time with their uncle instead of their mother. All that, plus find out who's ass Tommy Tapeworm will come wriggling out of.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Core, The Thief, His Wife and Her Lover, The
programme.desc: The creators imagine just how far Kratos, from the God of War series, will go to collect blood orbs. Superman flies back through time so he won't have to hear Lois whine... ever again. The Velveteen Rabbit gets a raw deal. And what did the aliens from Close Encounters of the Third Kind really come to prove?

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Godfather of the Bride II, The
programme.desc: Remember when MTV used to actually be about music? The MTV logo does and it's out for revenge. The Robot Chicken Nerd dreams of hanging out with Michael Knight from Knight Rider. A bunch of Spock's from the future gather for a surprise party and the creators imagine what television will be like in the year 2013.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Curious Case of the Box, The
programme.desc: The creators re-imagine the moment before death in Reaped, Dora the Explorer conquers Mt. Everest, God gets busted in the Garden of Eden and witness the most horrifyingly hysterical car clown crash in history.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Magneto makes Iron Man a ballet legend in Iron Marionette, Morpheus leaves a message on Neo's answering machine, Walt Whitman causes trouble for a modern day high school student and the creators imagine a musical number from Grand Theft Auto's Gay Tony.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Ever wonder how Doc Brown got the plutonium from the Libyan terrorists? Find out here! The creators imagine what it would be like if Jesus came down to talk to us normal humans. See what life would be like for Bella and Edward, who is a 109-year-old vampire.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators imagine what the movie Sex and the City 3 will be like if made more guy friendly, Yogi Bear battles with the Power Rangers from Jellystone Park, find out why no one cares about Woody Woodpecker anymore and see the nail biting, hair raising, super big finish of Season Five in Robot Chicken's 100th episode finale!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Season Six flies in with a brand spankin' new opening credit sequence! G.I. Joe faces their biggest challenge yet; Find out what being a vegetarian is really all about; the questions about Starbucks famous logo are answered; Orville Redenbacher stars in Children of the Popcorn.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Crushed by a Steamroller on My 53rd Birthday
programme.desc: Alvin and the Chipmunks have a wild time after a concert; Mary Poppins isn't quite the nanny anyone expected; Find out why B.A. Baracus hates flying so much; G.I. Joe in a real war situation in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Fast and the Furious 6; Wilson from Cast Away stars in a Bourne Identity type role; Odd Job has a rough day off at the park; Lisbeth Salander joins the Scooby-Doo crew.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: How Osama Bin Laden really died; The Shirt Tales take to the skies in WWII; King Don rules with an iron fist and creamy goodness; Overweight cartoon characters join the cast of The Fattest Loser!

programme.title: Happily Ever Arranged?
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.desc: When 15-year-old Tyson attends public school for the first time, his life changes forever. While helping his father clean up after the football team, he befriends champion marathon runner Aklilu. With the help of an unlikely friend and his parents, he soon learns that anything is possible when you have faith in yourself and the courage to take the first step.

When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.desc: A karate class leads to some killer blows in Gresham, OR, and a millionaire has a dangerous temper in Worcestershire, England.

programme.desc: Bob Bosley is a successful, married businessman. But he goes on his luxury boat with attractive women for wild parties. Then someone shoots him. Police wonder if it's a jealous husband, a business rival, or someone closer to home.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Independence, MO a deeply religious couple's marriage runs into trouble. When they seek spiritual counseling things go from bad to worse and one of them indulges in an affair which leads to murder.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: A former pizza parlor manager gets more than annoyed when his festive bonus payment is less than he is expecting. Mitchell Sims decides that armed robbery is a quicker way to get money, and unleashes a reign of terror in South Carolina.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In La Jolla, CA, investigators discover an unsettling site - a body surrounded by rose petals. Kristin Rossum says her husband Greg, a business manager, had been feeling unwell throughout the day before he mysteriously stopped breathing.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Flint, MI, Chuck Miller arrives at his brother's salvage yard and discovers a body. At first it looks like a robbery gone bad but as homicide investigators delve deep they uncover a steamy affair involving an ex-cop.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Newtown, CT attractive flight attendant Helle Crafts suddenly goes missing. Her husband Richard, a pilot, first suggests she's visiting her mother, before confiding in detectives he suspects she's run off with a lover.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, VA, a husband devises an elaborate plot to get a payout from the U.S. Navy. It involves inviting a co-worker over for sex with his wife. But a double cross is followed by a triple cross and two people wind up dead.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In a suburb of Nashville, TN, Martha Freeman is enjoying steamy nights with a lover she's managed to sneak into the home she shares with her husband Jeffrey. And he's not just there for a few hours - he's moved permanently into her closet.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Clymer, south of Buffalo, NY, there is concern that school superintendent Keith Reed Jr. has disappeared. Police discover he had enjoyed a passionate night of sex with a married woman from Virginia - who has a jealous husband.

programme.title: Murderous Affairs
programme.desc: In Morgantown, WV, fire crews discover the body of Jimmy Michaels in bed. There's no obvious explanation for why he wouldn't have tried to escape the burning building until news of an affair starts to provide answers.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Pamela Hutchinson travels to Florida to attend a friend's funeral, but after extending her stay, she's found dead in her condo's bathroom. The local police launch into an investigation, unveiling a threat that spans across the United States.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Just weeks before Christmas, in the sleepy town of Early, Iowa, two men break into the home of Tracey Richter and attack her while her children hide in a nearby bedroom. Tracey shoots and kills one of them in the process, claiming self-defense. But as investigators look closer at the case, something about her story just doesn't add up.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Police in Chicago, Illinois connect a series of local murders that ends up putting them on the hunt for a serial killer. Little do they know, their target has been busy on the other side of the country, hunting women in the California desert.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: An Olympic shot putt athlete is found dead in his own yard, shot multiple times. Police determine that this murder was no random act of violence, and the evidence soon uncovers a series of dark family secrets that threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Body builder Doug and his deputy sheriff girlfriend Tracy bond over their love of weightlifting, but all they do lately is quarrel. When Doug's body is discovered encased in concrete, all fingers point to Tracy. But Tracy insists that it's physically impossible and she's being framed by the same sheriff's department she once worked for.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon's badly decomposing body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend's mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. But when they learn their relationship has recently been rocky, no one is sure whether they're hunting for a victim...or a killer.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Jeremy Simko is a firearms enthusiast whose property is outfitted with every conceivable security device, from motion detectors, to cameras, to savage, barking dogs. So when his wife Julene finds him shot to death in their bed one night, the question for police is, how could an intruder possibly have gained access to the Simko bedroom?

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: In Newport Beach, California, millionaire medical innovator Bill McLaughlin is living a luxurious life inside the gated community of Balboa Coves - until he is shot six times in his own kitchen. When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Newlyweds Katie and JD have ever-escalating tension with JD's ex-wife Robin. When Robin is found shot to death, in an apparent robbery gone wrong, police arrest the killer. Or...do they? There is a demon in disguise and only a last-minute discovery will lead detectives to the truth.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Keith Gentry is shot in his sleep in the middle of the night, and left to be found by his wife, Darlene. The Texas Rangers are then brought in to investigate the murder, wading through discrepancies and lies as they narrow in on their suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a man's family and co-workers lose touch with him and can't find any trace of him for days, the police are sent to his apartment to investigate and see what they can figure it out. But what they find is far worse than any of them expected.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: On an unusually warm September morning beloved yoga instructor Michael Dojaquez is found shot dead on his front porch. With a rash of violent home burglaries reported in his Tucson neighborhood in recent weeks, detectives line up the usual suspects only to find themselves spinning down the rabbit hole of a bizarre 'love triangle' homicide investigation with no murder weapon and the perfect alibi.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Marc Despain is discovered by his wife Michelle, shot dead in his kitchen with the house made to look like it had been burglarized. But the evidence soon leads police to members of Marc's own inner circle, where long-standing blood feuds may have reached the boiling point and led to Marc's murder.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Tireless nurse Bonnie Woodward would never simply disappear and leave her family behind - that's not the type of person she was. After she is murdered, investigators believe they have her killer but it takes 10 years to break the case wide open.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Trenton Mallory and fiance Amber Smith of Levering, Michigan have had their ups and downs in recent years. Things finally seem to be on the upswing when 'Trading Trent' as he is known because of his hobby of buying and selling guns is found shot in his bed while still asleep.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Petoskey, Michigan, blue-collar worker Lyle Kopenkoskey is a well-liked man who lives a simple life with his wife of nearly 40 years, Carol. But everything changes one cold October night when Lyle is found dead only a mile from his home. With minimal evidence and a lack of suspects, investigators find themselves racing against the clock to prevent the case from going cold.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Vince is a seasoned New Orleans sportscaster, and his marriage to the much younger Liz looks like a second chance for them both. When Liz is shot point blank in the face, police pursue a notorious vagrant who fits the witness's description. But the more police dig into this murder, the game appears to be bigamy, and all the rules are off the table.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Beloved congregation member Rhonda Smith seems like the last person who'd be found shot to death at church. programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: In Pensacola, Florida, ex-cop and private investigator Taylor Wright is moving into a new home with the love of her love when she inexplicably disappears without a trace. At first it appears as if she may have simply run away.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: There have only been two reported murders among the Amish in America in more than 250 years. Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.
